cards.complexityReason: SUBMIT action changes workflow state, creates a human task, branches routing on leadership group membership, and writes multiple aggregates (Ask, AskVersion, WorkflowTask, WorkflowDecision, WorkflowHistory, OutboxMessage, Comment, Audit) atomically.

differences.specValue: Numeric status IDs 123 (In Progress), 127 (PPL Review), 145 (DPP Ops Review)
differences.masterLldValue: Named states only: Draft, Pending PPL Approval, etc. (MLLD §7.4); no numeric ID mapping present

differences.item: HTTP error status code for business rule violations
differences.specValue: 422 for date constraint and FTE violations (AC5, AC7, Error Behaviour section)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD error catalogue (MLLD §12.2) defines 400 validation_failed for invalid requests; 422 is not listed

differences.specValue: Leadership group submitter routes directly to status 145 DPP Ops Review, bypassing PPL Review (BR25, AC3)
differences.masterLldValue: MLLD §7.4 references 'Leadership submitter shortcut' but detail is unconfirmed (open item LLD T03)

differences.item: buttonValue=Exit accepted by the API as a no-op
differences.specValue: API accepts Exit buttonValue and returns success without persisting data (FR6, AC4)
differences.masterLldValue: No equivalent pattern in Master LLD; exit/cancel-before-save is a UI concern with no API counterpart in the catalogue

missingFacts.item: Status ID to name mapping: 123, 127, 145 — exact named-state equivalents not confirmed in any approved source
'Top-3 set' for levelNeedId referenced in BR17 — specific reference data IDs not defined
'First option' ID for needReasonId (BR6) and generalSpecialityNeedId (BR7) — specific reference data IDs not defined
'Retirement' value for needReasonId referenced in BR11 — specific reference data ID not defined
Leadership group membership rule and attribute source used for routing decision (BR24, BR25, AC2, AC3) — not present in RBAC matrix reference
Exact permission code for 'Create New ASK' — permission name not specified in spec or RBAC matrix reference
Success HTTP status code — spec states 200 or 201 but does not confirm which applies for a create operation
Idempotency key requirement and scope for the create command — not specified in spec
Transaction scope across Ask, Task, Comment, Audit, and Attachment entities — explicitly unconfirmed in spec (Assumption 1)
'New-version only' field semantics for pml, titlingCategory, transitionalCoach (BR9, BR18, BR19) — not clarified whether this create operation is the new version context

assumptions: buttonValue=Exit is treated as a server-side no-op returning success without persistence (confirmed in spec Assumption 2).
Attachment file-upload contract is represented as a file upload array in the request body (confirmed in spec Assumption 3).
All entities (Ask, Task, Comment, Audit, Attachments) are created atomically or not at all — transaction behaviour is unconfirmed and recorded as a missing fact.
Leadership group membership is resolved from the authenticated caller's server-side profile, never from the request body (SEC 003).
The 'new-version only' field qualifier in BR9, BR18, BR19 applies to this initial create operation as version 1.
